description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity of an Android application demonstrating app restrictions. It manages UI components, reads application restrictions from UserManager, and displays them, providing a user interface to view and modify app restriction settings in restricted profiles.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity that displays and manages app restrictions, handles user interface events, and reads restrictions from the UserManager service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI elements and loads preferences when the activity is created.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reads and displays the current app restrictions each time the activity resumes.

methods.name: onCustomClicked
methods.description: Handles the event when the custom restriction checkbox is clicked, saving its state to shared preferences.
